candidateTestedAndDropped.hypothesis: run() re-calls prepareTimeline(roots, collapsed) on every loop iteration though both args are loop-invariant; hoisting it per shape should cut the two hot tests.
candidateTestedAndDropped.safetyGate: CLEARED. layout() only reads `prepared` — LayoutInput documents it as a 'memoized tree walk; recomputed here when absent', and timeCompressionFor's JSDoc says to memoize on [prepared, box.width, compress]. Reuse across box widths and compress values is the intended production path. prepareTimeline is a pure iterative tree walk returning a fresh object.

verification.command: npx --yes pnpm@10 exec vitest run --project client src/features/traces/fns/timeline/layout.clienttest.ts (cwd web/)
verification.result: NO WIN — the delta is inside run-to-run noise.

candidateTestedAndDropped.whyTheHypothesisWasWrong: prepareTimeline is not the cost. With no rowRange, layout() positions ALL rows, so TIMELINE_SHAPES.huge (manySpans(10_000)) drives ~140,000 positionRow calls across the 10 shapes x 7 boxes x 2 compress combinations in the 'stays finite' test alone. The tree walk is noise beside that. Cutting the positioning work would mean cutting coverage, which the rules forbid.
candidateTestedAndDropped.disposition: DEAD. Do not re-attempt. Temporary edits were reverted; working tree confirmed clean.

notARegression.conclusion: Test count nearly doubled — this is added coverage, not a slowdown. Per-test cost is flat (~2.6s -> ~2.8s). The two heaviest cases are 18.05s and 18.02s SSRF connect-timeout waits, which are the point of the test. Do not re-flag without a per-test-cost change.
